source._comment: MD State Board of Elections posts an 'Official Turnout (By Party and County)' PDF with sections Democrat / Republican / Libertarian / Unaffiliated / Other Parties, each a county table with columns Election Day, Early Voting, Vote By Mail, Provisional, Eligible Voters, Turnout% -> full party x method x county. Requires pypdf (MD workflow step installs it). During the general the file lives under press_room/2026_stats/; the exact daily-vs-official cadence and filename are confirmed by the routine in Oct (general_candidates lists the likely names). validation_url is the persisted 2024 file used by --validate. Baltimore City = FIPS 24510 (renamed 'Baltimore City' in geometry), Baltimore County = 24005.
source._mail_comment: Before the official turnout PDF exists, md_update.py reads the SBE's daily 'Mail-in Sent and Returned' by county workbook (GG26 folder; 'ALL' category rows = county totals; DEM/REP/OTH sent & received, OTH includes unaffiliated). If neither is reachable it falls back to the UF Election Lab stand-in. In-person early voting (Oct 22+) is in GG26/'EarlyVoting RAW data.csv' -- not wired yet.
